main_issue: Whether and how Agent D can keep cooking strong-smelling curry in the shared kitchen without the smell affecting the others' work, clothes and laundry

A-B.evidence: Both object to the smell (T1, T2). A accepts after-7 cooking (T7), and B accepts once a week (T18). They never address each other directly, and A is silent on the final arrangement.

A-C.evidence: Both complain about the smell (T1, T3). C accepts the Tuesday/Thursday arrangement (T21+). A accepted after-7 cooking (T7) and never spoke to C.

A-D.evidence: A opens by asking for no smelly cooking at all (T1). D replies that the only kitchen is shared (T4). A then asks for cooking after 7 (T5), D agrees (T6), and A accepts (T7).

B-C.evidence: C rejects B's window idea (T13). Both then accept once a week, with C's day constraint (T18, T19, T21). Their positions were never opposed.

B-D.evidence: B says the smell still reaches the room (T8). B proposes cooking once a week (T16), D agrees (T17), and B accepts (T18).

C-D.evidence: C says night cooking still smells up the laundry (T9). C names the laundry days (T19), D agrees to Tuesday or Thursday (T20), and C accepts repeatedly (T21+).
